LOCAL HEALTH INTELLIGENCE
Ask about averages, trends, highest/lowest readings, gaps, and possible watchpoints. I use only actual entries saved in this browser, never the illustrated values in the dashboard screenshot. For more flexible language understanding, you can optionally connect a locally running Ollama model in Settings.

Optional real language model — Ollama on your computer

Connection: http://127.0.0.1:11434 (your own device). No passwords or API keys are stored. This page contacts only your localhost Ollama server, which may have its own data-handling configuration. It receives your question and only an anonymized statistical summary if you explicitly allow it.

Not a diagnosis, emergency monitor, or medical professional. For emergency symptoms call 911.

◈ BMI EVOLUTION & BODY WEIGHT

◈ PAIRED BLOOD PRESSURE

Pulse pressure = systolic − diastolic. Estimated MAP = (systolic + 2 × diastolic) ÷ 3, from paired values in the same entry; estimates are not invasive measurements.

◈ ALL RECORDED MEASUREMENTS — STATISTICS

MetricRecordsLatestMeanMedianStd. dev.Min–MaxFirst→LastWeekly slopeChart

◈ OTHER RECORDED INFORMATION

BMI is weight (kg) divided by height (m) squared. CDC BMI categories apply to adults aged 20+ only and are screening references, not diagnoses. Every displayed average is an average of recorded observations—not a continuous or 24-hour average. Slopes are historical least-squares estimates, not future predictions. No data is sent to the internet by this statistics viewer.
